summary: Split tally/reports.py into the tally/reports/ package (errors, tables, state, system, formatting, model, loading, aggregate, renderers, cli) following docs/refactoring.md; all modules are under 400 lines, the import graph is layered and acyclic, and the 63 tests pass with patch targets moved to tally.reports.system. A 608-case CLI comparison against the original matched byte for byte on stdout, stderr and exit status, except two uncaught-traceback cases (digest on files with no valid header), where the path and the exception's module name in the traceback inevitably differ.
